messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Pinnacle Financial just flagged a CISO-level blocker on the POC. They say SSO + HSM key management + egress restrictions must be validated before exec sign-off. Can we get an internal snapshot of what we can commit to by EOD?
Jordan Patel: Thanks Maria. Which pieces are blocking the demo next week?
Maria Chen: Two things: 1) they want proof of SSO integration (SAML) + audit logs; 2) their security team wants a sketch of how keys are handled (KMS vs HSM) and whether we support customer-managed keys.
Ryan Li: For SAML we have a standard flow — can provide a short demo and SAML metadata. For CMK/KMS we support KMS integrations in Private deployments; hosted API uses our managed KMS. We can propose a compromise: dedicated Private deployment for POC with KMS in their AWS account.
Priya Rao: Quick note from security: Pinnacle is asking for HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2) and full audit logs for all admin actions. We need to confirm which logs are available for the Private package and retention.
Alex Gomez: I can share the audit log schema we ship in Dedicated/Private. It's in the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-log-schema (will copy relevant excerpts).
Jordan Patel: Can someone post the minimal config they'd need to whitelist their network? They want IP allowlist + egress control.
infra-bot: deploy-plan-checker: current sandbox pool IPs: [3.120.45.67, 3.120.45.68] — recommend using NAT gateway + proxy for egress control.
Ryan Li: Sample allowlist snippet (for their firewall):
```
ALLOW 3.120.45.67/32 tcp 443
ALLOW 3.120.45.68/32 tcp 443
```
We'll provide a signed certificate and SAN for the demo endpoint.
Maria Chen: Pricing question: Pinnacle expects a committed unit price tied to tokens and a 12-month SLA. They asked for an initial figure during exec sync — what's safe to promise?
Alex Gomez: Don't give a final price. Offer a provisional POC credit and say pricing will be finalized with Sales Ops after we confirm Private deployment scope.
Priya Rao: Action items from sec POV: 1) Confirm HSM support or acceptable KMS alternative; 2) Provide audit log export samples; 3) Share SAML setup guide and proof we can produce admin/audit records post-auth. I can own 1 and 2 if someone helps with artifacts.
Jordan Patel: I can produce the SAML metadata + a short recorded walkthrough by EOD.
Ryan Li: I'll draft the POC scope that limits data residency (no egress to third-party) and propose Dedicated pool in us-east-1. Will add cost estimate and uplift for HSM.
Maria Chen: Can we get a CISO-level readout/slide for Friday? Pinnacle requested an exec-to-exec 30-min call on Mon. Need one slide on security posture, one on deployment model, and a one-line pricing ask.
Priya Rao: I'll draft the security slide. Jordan — can you export a sample audit log (anonymized) and drop it here?
Jordan Patel: On it. I'll sanitize and upload by 6pm.
Alex Gomez: I'll prep the pricing ask language: "Provisional POC terms: 6-week POC, Dedicated pool with customer-managed KMS in customer's AWS account; nominal POC fee waived with commitment to enter a dedicated contract contingent on security review." Thoughts?
Maria Chen: That's good. Ryan — can you run the uplift calc and give a round number we can show the execs (ballpark) so they see cost delta for HSM/backed keys?
Ryan Li: I'll run numbers and reply in thread. Expect a ballpark by 5:30pm.
infra-bot: NOTE: provisioning time for a Private Dedicated sandbox with CMK binding is ~72 hours once infra ticket approved.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — main blockers captured. If we can get the SAML demo (Jordan), audit logs (Jordan/Alex), and the security slide (Priya) by EOD we can prep for the exec sync. I will schedule the CISO call once slides are ready. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: A couple more quick Qs from me to the thread: do we have an SOC2 attachment for Private customers? Also, can we commit to preserving request-level logs for 90 days?
Alex Gomez: We have SOC2 Type II reports available under NDA. Log retention for Private can be configured to 90 days; default hosted retention is 30 days.
Maria Chen: Great — looks like we have a path. I'll assemble everything into an internal brief and ping legal for the NDA.
Ryan Li: Ballpark HSM uplift: +18-22% on hosting costs for dedicated HSM vs managed KMS, rough estimate. Will firm up.
Jordan Patel: Uploaded sanitized audit sample: https://redwood.share/sanitized-audit-pinnacle.json
Maria Chen: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll follow up with the schedule and slide deck link.
Alex Gomez: I'll prepare the pricing blurb for the slide deck and post here when done.
Priya Rao: Filing a security ticket to track the HSM/KMS decision: SEC-4821.
Maria Chen: Closing loop — last_message_ts set to 1846507890 per thread.
